title: Kingdom-wide comparative transcriptomics reveals deeply conserved and predictable stress response programs across Viridiplantae.
authors: Koh, Eugene; Peh, Li Hui; Tan, Sabrina; Koh, Teng-Seah; Chin, Li-Li; Ho, Boon-Chuan; Mutwil, Marek
one_liner_zh: 该文构建植物界跨物种胁迫转录组图谱，用DNA/RNA基础模型预测胁迫响应，但对象为基因表达而非染色质三维组织，无空间架构建模，仅序列预测方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: How conserved stress responses are across the plant kingdom remains poorly understood. Here, we present a kingdom-wide stress transcriptome atlas of 36 Viridiplantae species, from chlorophytes to angiosperms, across nine abiotic and biotic stresses. The atlas integrates reanalyzed public RNA-seq data with new in-house stress experiments on three species representing basal lineages, yielding 13.6 million differential expression calls from over 3,200 manually curated control-treatment comparisons. We find that ancient gene families respond broadly but moderately, while lineage-specific families respond narrowly but intensely, revealing a division of labor in stress gene deployment. Stress response conservation decays with phylogenetic distance yet remains detectable across more than 700 million years of divergence, with upregulated genes diverging faster than downregulated genes. Functional co-occurrence analysis uncovers a deeply conserved growth-defense tradeoff alongside stress-specific transcriptional rewiring. Conserved stress co-expression modules undergo regulatory sub-functionalization through duplication, with whole-genome duplicate pairs preferentially retained within modules. Finally, DNA and RNA foundation models predict stress responsiveness from sequence alone (auROC 0.755), suggesting a partially conserved cis-regulatory code underlying stress responses across the kingdom.
abstract_zh: 植物界中应激反应的保守程度至今仍知之甚少。在此，我们呈现了一个涵盖36种绿色植物（Viridiplantae）物种、从绿藻到被子植物、跨越九种非生物和生物胁迫的植物界级应激转录组图谱。该图谱整合了重新分析的公共RNA-seq数据，以及对代表基部谱系的三个物种进行的新内部胁迫实验，从超过3,200个手动整理的对照-处理比较中产生了1,360万个差异表达调用。我们发现，古老基因家族响应广泛但程度适中，而谱系特异性家族响应狭窄但强烈，揭示了应激基因部署中的分工机制。应激反应保守性随系统发育距离增加而衰减，但在超过7亿年的分化中仍可检测到，其中上调基因的进化速度快于下调基因。功能共现分析揭示了一个深度保守的生长-防御权衡，以及应激特异性转录重连。保守的应激共表达模块通过复制经历调控亚功能化，其中全基因组重复对优先保留在模块内。最后，DNA和RNA基础模型仅从序列即可预测应激响应性（auROC 0.755），表明植物界中应激反应背后存在部分保守的顺式调控编码。
